presets.name: Show Log Server Storage and Indexer Status
presets.script:
export LC_ALL=C
printf "
__LOG_VOLUME__
"; if [ -n "$FWDIR" ]; then df -Pk -- "$FWDIR/log" 2>&1; fi
printf "
__INDEX_VOLUME__
"; if [ -n "$RTDIR" ]; then df -Pk -- "$RTDIR/log_indexes" 2>&1; fi
printf "
__INDEXER__
"; cpstat -f indexer mg 2>&1 || printf "
__INDEXER_FAILED__
"
presets.description: Read filesystem usage and indexer status on a Gaia server with Logging & Status enabled.

presets.name: Show Cluster Member Logging and Clock Health
presets.script:
export LC_ALL=C
printf "
__LOG_CONNECTION__
"
cpstat -f log_connection fw
printf "
__CLOCK__
"
printf "__TIME_EPOCH__="; date -u +%s; printf "
__NTP_ACTIVE__="; clish -c "show ntp active" 2>&1; printf "
__NTP_CURRENT__="; clish -c "show ntp current" 2>&1
printf "
__CLUSTER_STATE__
"
cphaprob state 2>&1 || true
presets.description: Read a Gaia ClusterXL member’s log connections, UTC clock, NTP evidence, and local cluster state.
